description: Renovate repository configuration (tracker #2551, part 1 #2996, part 2 #2998, part 3 #2999, cutover #2562).
Literal copies of a pin (docs, contract probes, source constants) have a custom manager each, so Renovate rewrites them in the canonical pin's PR; prBodyNotes list the places no rewrite can reach.

Normal groups open PRs on their schedules. Majors, Cargo lock-file maintenance (the one manager with lock files, monthly) and the manual rows still wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard. Security updates (vulnerabilityAlerts) open at the next run with no schedule, hold or release-age wait, labelled dependencies and urgent. The cutover (#2562) removed the top-level hold and Dependabot version updates.

Post-upgrade tasks (#2999): one run per update branch, each a repository script that reads the data file and acts only on the upgrades it owns. pin_checksums.py rewrites the checksums and paired values of a bumped download pin; renovate_artifacts.py agent-cli-lock refreshes the agent CLI lockfile after a manifest bump and renovate_artifacts.py constraints regenerates .github/ci/constraints.txt after a pyproject.toml or .github/ci/requirements-*.txt bump, pinning each proposed version.

The commands run only repository scripts from the runner's own default-branch checkout, mounted read-only at /opt/booley, never code from the update branch, and the runner's RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS admits them by anchored patterns. npm runs with --ignore-scripts in a directory holding only its two files, uv with --no-build --no-config. A failing command is an artifact error on the PR, never a committed wrong value.
fileFilters lists exactly the files the scripts write. Keep it, the allowlist in .github/workflows/renovate.yml and tests/ci/test_renovate_config.py in step.
Keep the exact-name selectors in packageRules in step with tests/ci/test_renovate_config.py.

customManagers.description: Sandbox Dockerfile pin annotations (tests/docker/test_dockerfile_pins.py owns the format): version pins and tag-plus-commit companions.
matchStrings:
# renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>\S+) depName=(?<depName>\S+)(?: packageName=(?<packageName>\S+))?(?: versioning=(?<versioning>\S+))?(?: extractVersion=(?<extractVersion>\S+))?
ARG \w+=(?<currentValue>\S+)(?:
# pin-companion: \w+
ARG \w+_REF=(?<currentDigest>[0-9a-f]{40}))?

customManagers.description: Sandbox Dockerfile annotations of a pin that follows a branch: the ARG is the commit digest and currentValue is the branch.

packageRules.description: Noise: runner images and apt packages are not pins.
Noise: the VS Code engines range is a compatibility floor, not a pin.
The npm alias npm:@openai/codex@V-linux-x64 keeps its platform suffix. Its depName is the alias and its packageName is @openai/codex, so matchDepNames (not matchPackageNames) selects it.

The Ubuntu parent image follows Ubuntu versioning wherever it appears. The Dockerfile manager sets this itself; the copies (the supported-tools row, the provenance LABELs) are regex matches and need the rule, or they would propose the next non-LTS release the pin does not follow.
Release age (3 days) only for datasources that publish release timestamps (#2552). Docker, git-refs and github-digest report none: under timestamp-required they would wait forever.
Agent CLIs: 1 day release age.
